notes.title: Flickering of the candle
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Some players have reported headache problems due to the flickering of the candle. It can now be disabled in Options -> FlickeringCandle

Thanks!

notes.title: Adjustments
notes.content:
[list]
[*] The number of Hints increases according to the size of the jigsaw.
[*] After assembling, the player can enjoy the image until he clicks on the "Continue" button.
[*] The color of the already assembled jigsaw changes to yellow in the jigsaw size selection menu.
[/list]
